name: Adyen API
tagline: Enterprise payment platform API for global card, wallet, and local payment processing
description: Adyen provides a unified payments platform API for accepting, processing, and managing card, digital wallet, and local payment methods worldwide. Developers use Checkout, Payments, and Management APIs with API-key authentication to create sessions, authorize transactions, handle refunds, and configure merchant accounts across test and live environments.

auth.details: API key via X-API-Key header; create keys in Customer Area. Separate test and live credentials.

pricing.paid_plans: Transaction-based pricing; contact sales for rates

use_cases: list available payment methods for a merchant
get payment details by PSP reference
